name: Circle of Wildfire
description: A druid subclass that adds the Wildfire tradition from Tasha's Cauldron of Everything.

grants.name: Wildfire Spirit
grants.description: Use the shared Wildfire Spirit stat block.

grants.name: Circle Spells
grants.description: Always prepare the Circle of Wildfire spells as your Druid level increases.

grants.name: Summon Wildfire Spirit
grants.description: As an Action, expend Wild Shape to summon a Wildfire Spirit for 1 hour. Its arrival can deal 2d6 Fire damage nearby, and you command its actions with a Bonus Action.

grants.name: Enhanced Bond
grants.description: While your Wildfire Spirit is present, one damage or healing roll of a Fire or restorative spell gains 1d8, and eligible spells can originate from the spirit's space.

grants.name: Cauterizing Flames
grants.description: When a Small or larger creature dies within 30 feet, use your Reaction to create a spectral flame. A creature entering it can take 2d10 plus Wisdom Fire damage or regain that many Hit Points. Uses equal your Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

grants.name: Blazing Revival
grants.description: When you drop to 0 Hit Points while your Wildfire Spirit is within 120 feet, dismiss the spirit and regain half your maximum Hit Points. Once per Long Rest.
